description: Probe-set to gene mapping for GPL13158, so a predictor's feature_id is declared from a platform annotation rather than looked up after seeing a result table.
gpl_title: [HT_HG-U133_Plus_PM] Affymetrix HT HG-U133+ PM Array Plate
caveat: A gene with more than one probeset has no single feature_id. Declare the set and combine it with an explicit rule; do not pick one after seeing the result table.
